Action.description: What a client may do with one open decision.
Action.title: Action

ActivityEntry.description: One `log.md` bullet: its section date and its text.
ActivityEntry.title: ActivityEntry

Applied.description:
The action took effect. `commit_sha` is `None` when the auto-commit
degraded (the write itself still landed). `committed_confidential` is true
only when a commit landed and holds a concept explicitly marked
`sensitivity: confidential`; an adapter that has no notice of its own to
print leaves it false, and one that reports it sets it from the commit's
outcome.
Applied.title: Applied

ApplyRequest.description:
The action, the version the preview issued (echoed unchanged) and how
long to wait for the workspace lock; a client can shorten the wait only.
ApplyRequest.title: ApplyRequest

ApplyResponse.description:
What was applied, and the warnings the apply raised along the way (for
example a commit that could not be made).
ApplyResponse.title: ApplyResponse

Decision.description: One open decision, as data a client can render.
Decision.title: Decision

DecisionList.description: Every open decision, in an envelope that leaves room for additive fields.
DecisionList.title: DecisionList

DecisionPreview.description:
`api.DecisionPreview` with its plan declared as a discriminated union. The
field names are `openkos.api`'s own. A response model only: no
`extra="forbid"`, which would reach the nested dataclasses and split their
components into `-Input` and `-Output` variants.
DecisionPreview.title: DecisionPreview

DecisionVersion.description:
The version a stateless caller commits against.

`payload_digest` proves the queue row, its proposal and its recorded
inputs are unchanged; `content_digest` proves the bytes the human saw are
the bytes that would be written. `payload_digest` is `None` when no queue
row backs the item, which the token path rejects. `decision_key` is the
handle: a findings row id is never used, because the cache is derived.
DecisionVersion.title: DecisionVersion

ErrorBody.description: The one body shape of every non-2xx response.
ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody

GroupSelection.description:
The members a person marked the same, and the one that stays.

`member_ids` are the marked members, the survivor included. A selection
is data the caller supplies to a `merge_group` preview and is carried in
the `DecisionVersion` it returns, so an altered selection is a stale
version. It is canonicalised (deduplicated, ascending) by
`validate_selection` before it enters a version.
GroupSelection.title: GroupSelection

HealthCounts.description:
How many findings each knowledge-health check reports. Counts only; the
findings themselves are not part of the surface.
HealthCounts.title: HealthCounts

IdentityDetail.description: An identity decision: a group that may be one entity.
IdentityDetail.title: IdentityDetail

JudgingOutcomeBody.description: What a judging run returned, field for field, with a failure as a body.
JudgingOutcomeBody.title: JudgingOutcomeBody

KeepDistinctPlan.description: Recording that these concepts are different things.
KeepDistinctPlan.title: KeepDistinctPlan

KindCounts.description: Lifetime counters of one pending-work kind.
KindCounts.title: KindCounts

KindRefresh.description: What one refresh did for one kind of decision.
KindRefresh.title: KindRefresh

MergeHistory.description:
What was merged into a concept, newest first, in an envelope that leaves
room for additive fields.
MergeHistory.title: MergeHistory

MergePlan.description:
Merging concepts into a survivor: one pairwise merge, or, for
`merge_group`, one per marked member.
MergePlan.title: MergePlan

MergeRecord.description: One merge recorded on a concept: `survivor_id` absorbed `absorbed_id`.
MergeRecord.title: MergeRecord

MergeStep.description: One pairwise merge of a plan: `survivor_id` absorbs `absorbed_id`.
MergeStep.title: MergeStep

PendingRow.description: One open pending-work row and the command that resolves it.
PendingRow.title: PendingRow

PreviewPlan.description:
The plan of a preview, declared as a discriminated union.

The plan types carry a literal `kind`, so the OpenAPI document names it as the
discriminator and a generated client narrows `plan` with `switch (plan.kind)`.
The plan types are `openkos.api`'s own, and the wrapper serialises as the bare
plan. A defaulted `kind` is always sent, so the response schema marks it (and
every other defaulted plan field) required. That flag lives HERE and not on
`DecisionPreview`, because it reaches every nested dataclass: on the preview it
would also mark `DecisionVersion.selection` required in the response only, and
`DecisionVersion`, which a client echoes back in a request, would split into
`-Input` and `-Output` components.
PreviewPlan.title: PreviewPlan

PreviewRequest.description:
Which action to preview for the decision named in the path, and, for
`merge_group` only, the members the person marked and the survivor.

A request model that carries a nested API dataclass, so it rejects unknown
top-level keys itself (see `_EchoRequest`) rather than through `extra="forbid"`,
which would split `GroupSelection` into `-Input` and `-Output` components.
PreviewRequest.title: PreviewRequest

QueueRefresh.description: The three per-kind results of one refresh.
QueueRefresh.title: QueueRefresh

QuoteBinding.description: What consent was given to. A change of any field is `QuoteStale`.
QuoteBinding.title: QuoteBinding

QuoteRequest.description:
Which judging to price, and whether the quote may include what the run
needs consent for.
QuoteRequest.title: QuoteRequest

QuoteToken.description:
The context consent was given for. It holds no time: a token is stale
only when a binding field moved, decided by resolved values and digests.
QuoteToken.title: QuoteToken

RefreshRequest.description: How long a queue refresh waits for the workspace lock.
RefreshRequest.title: RefreshRequest

RelatePlan.description: Writing one typed relation, as it would be written.
RelatePlan.title: RelatePlan

RelationDetail.description: A relation-type decision: a suggested type for one untyped edge.
RelationDetail.title: RelationDetail

RunRequest.description:
The quote's token, echoed unchanged. A missing or null token is a
refusal the route answers (422 `run_refused`), not a validation error.
RunRequest.title: RunRequest

RunStatus.description:
A judging run as a poll sees it. The run's own result is a field here,
never the poll's HTTP status.
RunStatus.title: RunStatus

TierDetail.description: A volatility decision: a suggested tier for one concept type.
TierDetail.title: TierDetail

TierPlan.description: Setting one concept type's volatility tier.
TierPlan.title: TierPlan

UnmergeApplyRequest.description:
The version the unmerge preview issued (echoed unchanged) and how long to
wait for the workspace lock; a client can shorten the wait only.
UnmergeApplyRequest.title: UnmergeApplyRequest

UnmergePreview.description:
What undoing a merge would do: every step in the order it runs, the
survivor's newer merges first, down to and including the named one.
UnmergePreview.title: UnmergePreview

UnmergePreviewRequest.description:
Which merge to undo: the survivor and the absorbed concept, and whether
the first step may discard an edit made to the survivor since its merge.
UnmergePreviewRequest.title: UnmergePreviewRequest

UnmergeResponse.description:
What the unmerge restored, and the warnings it raised along the way (for
example a commit that could not be made).
UnmergeResponse.title: UnmergeResponse

UnmergeStep.description:
One single-step unmerge of a plan: `absorbed_id` is restored beside
`survivor_id`, both to their bytes before that merge.
UnmergeStep.title: UnmergeStep

UnmergeVersion.description:
The version a stateless caller applies an unmerge against: echo it
unchanged. `content_digest` covers the ledger entries being reversed, every
file the steps restore, rewrite or recreate, and `discard_survivor_edits`,
so a changed bundle or an altered field is stale.
UnmergeVersion.title: UnmergeVersion

Unmerged.description:
The unmerge took effect: `restored_ids` are back beside the survivor, in
the order they were restored, each step committed on its own.
`commit_shas[i]` is `None` when that step's commit could not be made (the
restore itself still landed). `committed_confidential` is true when a
commit holds a concept explicitly marked confidential.
Unmerged.title: Unmerged

WithheldAction.description: An action the item's kind could offer but this item does not, and why.
WithheldAction.title: WithheldAction

WorkspaceStatus.description: What `openkos status` reads, as counts and strings.
WorkspaceStatus.title: WorkspaceStatus

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying a busy workspace.
Seconds to wait before retrying a busy workspace.
